properties.description: **Essential** — Baseline hygiene for Durable Task: the non-negotiable controls every deployment should enforce from day one. This tier protects against credential theft, unencrypted data exposure, and accidental data loss for Durable Task workloads. Maps to CIS Benchmarks, ISO 27001 Annex A.10 (cryptography) and A.12 (operations).

metadata.policyName: Durable Task schedulers should not allow open IP allowlists
